reviews.body: Thanks! The fields map exactly like LiteLLM's (`cache_read` to `cached_prompt_tokens`, `cache_creation` to `cached_creation_tokens`), with no double counting. I pushed one follow-up (0986d507): langchain-anthropic 1.7.7 sets `cache_creation` to 0 when there are cache writes and reports them as `ephemeral_5m_input_tokens` and `ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`, so those are now summed. A test covers it. Merging.
